issues: I fixed this one during the run, and it matters for other agents: the use_figma runtime skips hidden layers inside instances by default (figma.skipInvisibleInstanceChildren = true). A layer hidden in the main component therefore can't be found in an instance with findOne/findAll, so it can't be un-hidden either. In the first desktop pass, Global Pool lost its art group, both Gold Participate CTAs, rule 7 and the payout DEMO badge, and Orbit Rush lost its art group. I fixed those in place by setting figma.skipInvisibleInstanceChildren = false. That line is now in pending/pub-04/lib.js. Any other slice that edits instance layers hidden in the main component needs the same line.

Every use_figma call that built 3 frames hit the 60-second MCP timeout (d1, d2, m1, m2).
